name: Qiuzhe Hupo
source:
A prisoner transport helicopter exploded upon landing, causing incalculable damage. The prisoner also vanished mysteriously, with no word on whether they are alive or dead.

Most unbelievable of all—Amber, the agent in charge of the escort, who was at the center of the explosion, survived without a scratch.

Where did the prisoner go? Did the agent betray his duty? Why... was Amber able to survive the explosion?

Amber is taken to the interrogation room. He must clear his name within the 7 days of his detention... and find the truth for himself.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5352630/]Steam[/url]]
